Key.Original: Number of phones that can rely on this mast at the same time.
Key.English: Number of phones that can rely on this mast at the same time.
Key.French: Nombre de téléphones qui peuvent s’appuyer en même temps sur ce mât.

Key.Original: Network callsign of the mast (e.g. RLY-NORD-01). Visible in AT Relays and at the command post.
Key.English: Network callsign of the mast (e.g. RLY-NORD-01). Visible in AT Relays and at the command post.
Key.French: Indicatif réseau du mât (ex. RLY-NORD-01). Visible dans Relais AT et au poste.

Key.Original: Start at mission start (Zeus / mission leader)
Key.English: Start at mission start (Zeus / mission leader)
Key.French: Lancer au début de la mission (Zeus / chef de mission)

Key.Original: Simulated transmit power. Drops to zero if the mast is destroyed.
Key.English: Simulated transmit power. Drops to zero if the mast is destroyed.
Key.French: Puissance d’émission simulée. Passe à zéro si le mât est détruit.

Key.Original: Advertised reliability. It drops out of range or under fire, and falls to zero if the mast is destroyed.
Key.English: Advertised reliability. It drops out of range or under fire, and falls to zero if the mast is destroyed.
Key.French: Fiabilité annoncée. Elle baisse hors portée ou sous les tirs, et tombe à zéro si le mât est détruit.

Key.Original: Opens the radio relay dashboard with real-time status, error detection and management actions.
Key.English: Opens the radio relay dashboard with real-time status, error detection and management actions.
Key.French: Ouvre le tableau de bord des relais radio avec statut en temps réel, détection d'erreurs, et actions de gestion.

Key.Original: Run the survey at game start, or only on demand.
Key.English: Run the survey at game start, or only on demand.
Key.French: Lancer le relevé au début de partie, ou seulement à la demande.

Key.Original: wifi | ble | tracker | camera | phone | unknown
Key.English: wifi | ble | tracker | camera | phone | unknown
Key.French: wifi | ble | tracker | camera | phone | unknown

Key.Original: Label of the link certificate (e.g. North Relay, valid until December 2027).
Key.English: Label of the link certificate (e.g. North Relay, valid until December 2027).
Key.French: Libellé du certificat de liaison (ex. Relais Nord — valable jusqu’à décembre 2027).

Key.Original: Fieldwatch RF emitter. Place the module, choose the band (Wi‑Fi / BLE / tracker / camera) and range. In game, the phone's Fieldwatch app scans nearby emitters and reports hits to the ATAK command post.
Key.English: Fieldwatch RF emitter. Place the module, choose the band (Wi‑Fi / BLE / tracker / camera) and range. In game, the phone's Fieldwatch app scans nearby emitters and reports hits to the ATAK command post.
Key.French: Émetteur RF Fieldwatch. Posez le module, choisissez bande (Wi‑Fi / BLE / tracker / caméra) et portée. En jeu, l’app Fieldwatch du téléphone scanne les émetteurs à proximité et remonte les hits au poste ATAK.

Key.Original: Immediately resyncs a specific relay to the ATHENA server. Place the module on the relay.
Key.English: Immediately resyncs a specific relay to the ATHENA server. Place the module on the relay.
Key.French: Resynchronise immédiatement un relais spécifique vers le serveur ATHENA. Placez le module sur le relais.

Key.Original: Scans every radio relay within a radius and uploads them to the ATHENA server. Shows a field-survey style report with visual feedback.
Key.English: Scans every radio relay within a radius and uploads them to the ATHENA server. Shows a field-survey style report with visual feedback.
Key.French: Scanne tous les relais radio dans un rayon et les remonte vers le serveur ATHENA. Affiche un rapport style relevé terrain avec feedback visuel.

Key.Original: Eden tutorial: ATAK relay (mast). 1) Place the module where the mast stands (hill, roof, LZ). 2) Fill in the name, identity, range, throughput, reliability, power, slots, network address, gateway and certificate: everything shows in the phone's AT Relays app and on the command post map. 3) Leave the address and gateway empty to have them generated. 4) The mast can be destroyed: a shot, a charge or a Zeus "kill" takes it out of service (throughput and power to zero, red dot at the command post). 5) If the "Require a relay" rule is on at the command post, a phone out of range of an intact mast no longer transmits. 6) Test: AT Relays should show the nearest mast, its grid, its occupied slots, and switch to "destroyed" as soon as the mast falls.
Key.English: Eden tutorial: ATAK relay (mast). 1) Place the module where the mast stands (hill, roof, LZ). 2) Fill in the name, identity, range, throughput, reliability, power, slots, network address, gateway and certificate: everything shows in the phone's AT Relays app and on the command post map. 3) Leave the address and gateway empty to have them generated. 4) The mast can be destroyed: a shot, a charge or a Zeus "kill" takes it out of service (throughput and power to zero, red dot at the command post). 5) If the "Require a relay" rule is on at the command post, a phone out of range of an intact mast no longer transmits. 6) Test: AT Relays should show the nearest mast, its grid, its occupied slots, and switch to "destroyed" as soon as the mast falls.
Key.French: Tutoriel Eden — Relais ATAK (mât). 1) Placez le module à l’endroit du mât (colline, toit, LZ). 2) Renseignez le nom, l’identité, la portée, le débit, la fiabilité, la puissance, les places, l’adresse réseau, la passerelle et le certificat — tout est visible dans l’application Relais AT du téléphone et sur la carte du poste. 3) Laissez l’adresse et la passerelle vides si vous voulez qu’elles soient générées. 4) Le mât est un objet détruisible : un tir, une charge ou un Zeus « tuer » le met hors service (débit et puissance à zéro, pastille rouge au poste). 5) Si la règle « Exiger un relais » est activée au poste, un téléphone hors de portée d’un mât intact ne transmet plus. 6) Testez : Relais AT doit afficher le mât le plus proche, sa grille, ses places occupées, et passer à « détruit » dès que le mât tombe.

Key.Original: Maximum distance at which Fieldwatch can hear this emitter.
Key.English: Maximum distance at which Fieldwatch can hear this emitter.
Key.French: Distance max à laquelle Fieldwatch peut entendre cet émetteur.

Key.Original: Area where the ATAK link is cut completely. Place it on the map, an object or a player.
Key.English: Area where the ATAK link is cut completely. Place it on the map, an object or a player.
Key.French: Zone où la liaison ATAK est totalement coupée. Posez sur la carte, un objet ou un joueur.

Key.Original: Simulated transmit power at the source (typ. -30 to 20).
Key.English: Simulated transmit power at the source (typ. -30 to 20).
Key.French: Puissance d’émission simulée à la source (typ. -30 à 20).

Key.Original: Show enemy AI on the map
Key.English: Show enemy AI on the map
Key.French: Afficher les IA ennemies sur la carte

Key.Original: Sends Athena the map's roads (highways, roads, tracks) and localities (cities, towns, villages, named places), without the full survey of buildings and terrain. Athena must be linked; the survey waits up to 3 minutes for the link. Once per map, unless "Send again".
Key.English: Sends Athena the map's roads (highways, roads, tracks) and localities (cities, towns, villages, named places), without the full survey of buildings and terrain. Athena must be linked; the survey waits up to 3 minutes for the link. Once per map, unless "Send again".
Key.French: Envoie à Athena les routes (autoroutes, routes, pistes) et les localités (villes, bourgs, villages, lieux-dits) de la carte, sans le relevé complet des bâtiments et du relief. Athena doit être liée ; le relevé attend la liaison jusqu'à 3 minutes. Une seule fois par carte, sauf « Renvoyer ».

Key.Original: Short name shown on the map and in the roster (e.g. RAVEN). Leave empty: the group name, otherwise the AI's name.
Key.English: Short name shown on the map and in the roster (e.g. RAVEN). Leave empty: the group name, otherwise the AI's name.
Key.French: Nom court affiché sur la carte et dans les effectifs (ex. RAVEN). Laisser vide : le nom du groupe, sinon le nom de l’IA.

Key.Original: By default, enemy contacts (red diamonds) do not appear at the command post. Choose to show them from the start, or keep them hidden: Zeus can show them during the mission.
Key.English: By default, enemy contacts (red diamonds) do not appear at the command post. Choose to show them from the start, or keep them hidden: Zeus can show them during the mission.
Key.French: Par défaut, les contacts ennemis (losanges rouges) n’apparaissent pas sur le poste. Choisissez de les afficher dès le début, ou de les laisser masqués : Zeus pourra les afficher en cours de mission.

Key.Original: Choose whether the full survey starts on its own at launch, or only from Zeus and this window.
Key.English: Choose whether the full survey starts on its own at launch, or only from Zeus and this window.
Key.French: Choisir si le relevé complet part tout seul au lancement, ou seulement depuis Zeus et cette fenêtre.

Key.Original: Degraded coverage area. Place it on the map, an object or a player.
Key.English: Degraded coverage area. Place it on the map, an object or a player.
Key.French: Zone de couverture dégradée. Posez sur la carte, un objet ou un joueur.

Key.Original: Hidden by default, or visible from the start. Zeus can change this choice during the mission.
Key.English: Hidden by default, or visible from the start. Zeus can change this choice during the mission.
Key.French: Masqués par défaut, ou visibles dès le début. Zeus peut changer ce choix en cours de mission.
Afficher dès le début de mission

Key.Original: Simulated gateway to the command post (e.g. 10.12.0.1). Empty = generated when placed.
Key.English: Simulated gateway to the command post (e.g. 10.12.0.1). Empty = generated when placed.
Key.French: Passerelle simulée vers le poste (ex. 10.12.0.1). Vide = générée à la pose.

Key.Original: Leave empty: the vehicle model is used. Useful to tell two vehicles of the same type apart (e.g. Convoy 1).
Key.English: Leave empty: the vehicle model is used. Useful to tell two vehicles of the same type apart (e.g. Convoy 1).
Key.French: Laisser vide : le modèle du véhicule est utilisé. Utile pour distinguer deux véhicules du même type (ex. Convoi 1).

Key.Original: Radius within which a phone can rely on this relay. Beyond this range, the relay can no longer be used.
Key.English: Radius within which a phone can rely on this relay. Beyond this range, the relay can no longer be used.
Key.French: Rayon dans lequel un téléphone peut s’appuyer sur ce relais. Hors de cette portée, le relais n’est plus utilisable.

Key.Original: The vehicle appears on the command map even with no player on board (AI convoy, stolen vehicle, beacon placed by the mission leader).
Key.English: The vehicle appears on the command map even with no player on board (AI convoy, stolen vehicle, beacon placed by the mission leader).
Key.French: Le véhicule apparaît sur la carte de commandement même sans joueur à bord (convoi IA, véhicule volé, balise posée par le chef de mission).

Key.Original: Active radio jammer. Place it on the map, a vehicle, an object or a player.
Key.English: Active radio jammer. Place it on the map, a vehicle, an object or a player.
Key.French: Brouilleur radio actif. Posez sur la carte, un véhicule, un objet ou un joueur.

Key.Original: Simulated address of the mast (e.g. 10.12.40.1). Leave empty to generate one when placed.
Key.English: Simulated address of the mast (e.g. 10.12.40.1). Leave empty to generate one when placed.
Key.French: Adresse simulée du mât (ex. 10.12.40.1). Laissez vide pour en générer une à la pose.

Key.Original: Name shown on the phone (AT Relays) and at the command post.
Key.English: Name shown on the phone (AT Relays) and at the command post.
Key.French: Nom affiché sur le téléphone (Relais AT) et au poste.

Key.Original: Enemy contacts do not appear at the command post until requested. Place this module to show them from the start, or let Zeus do it during the mission.
Key.English: Enemy contacts do not appear at the command post until requested. Place this module to show them from the start, or let Zeus do it during the mission.
Key.French: Les contacts ennemis n’apparaissent pas sur le poste tant que ce n’est pas demandé. Posez ce module pour les afficher dès le début, ou laissez Zeus le faire en cours de mission.

Key.Original: Name shown in Fieldwatch (e.g. IPCam-Lobby, Tile-AirTag).
Key.English: Name shown in Fieldwatch (e.g. IPCam-Lobby, Tile-AirTag).
Key.French: Nom affiché dans Fieldwatch (ex. IPCam-Lobby, Tile-AirTag).

Key.Original: This person's position appears on the command map, as if they carried a phone. By default, no detail (name, grid, heading…) is published: Zeus then chooses what appears, in game.
Key.English: This person's position appears on the command map, as if they carried a phone. By default, no detail (name, grid, heading…) is published: Zeus then chooses what appears, in game.
Key.French: La position de cette personne apparaît sur la carte de commandement, comme si elle portait un téléphone. Par défaut, aucun détail (nom, grille, cap…) n’est publié : le Zeus choisit ensuite ce qui apparaît, en jeu.

Key.Original: Advertised throughput. It drops with distance and damage, and falls to zero if the mast is destroyed.
Key.English: Advertised throughput. It drops with distance and damage, and falls to zero if the mast is destroyed.
Key.French: Débit annoncé. Il baisse avec la distance, les dégâts, et tombe à zéro si le mât est détruit.

Key.Original: Send again even if this map's roads and towns have already been sent.
Key.English: Send again even if this map's roads and towns have already been sent.
Key.French: Renvoyer même si routes et villes de cette carte ont déjà été transmises.

Key.Original: Leave empty: the person's name is used. Enter a callsign if several contacts share the same name.
Key.English: Leave empty: the person's name is used. Enter a callsign if several contacts share the same name.
Key.French: Laisser vide : le nom de la personne est utilisé. Renseignez un indicatif si plusieurs contacts ont le même nom.

Key.Original: Send roads and towns to Athena at launch (by Zeus or the mission leader), or only from Zeus.
Key.English: Send roads and towns to Athena at launch (by Zeus or the mission leader), or only from Zeus.
Key.French: Envoyer routes et villes à Athena au lancement (par le Zeus ou le chef de mission), ou seulement depuis Zeus.

Key.Original: Name shown in AT Relays and at the command post
Key.English: Name shown in AT Relays and at the command post
Key.French: Nom affiché sur Relais AT et au poste

Key.Original: Field biometric enrolment terminal. Opens an interpersonal intelligence record (SSE) on a screened person.
Key.English: Field biometric enrolment terminal. Opens an interpersonal intelligence record (SSE) on a screened person.
Key.French: Terminal d’enrôlement biométrique de terrain. Permet d’ouvrir une fiche de renseignement interpersonnel (SSE) sur une personne contrôlée.

Key.Original: This AI appears on the command map as a field unit (not as a phone). Useful for an escort section, a QRF or a friendly element. No effect on a player: they are already tracked if they carry a tablet.
Key.English: This AI appears on the command map as a field unit (not as a phone). Useful for an escort section, a QRF or a friendly element. No effect on a player: they are already tracked if they carry a tablet.
Key.French: Cette IA apparaît sur la carte de commandement comme une unité de terrain (pas comme un téléphone). Utile pour une section d’accompagnement, un QRF ou un élément ami. Sans effet sur un joueur : il est déjà suivi s’il a une tablette.
Envoyer au début de la mission

Key.Original: Strength of the network effect on the ATAK link (0 to 100).
Key.English: Strength of the network effect on the ATAK link (0 to 100).
Key.French: Force de l’effet réseau sur la liaison ATAK (0 à 100).

Key.Original: Covers the whole theatre: buildings, forests and terrain. A window shows the duration, the number of items collected and the current sector. Athena must be linked. The run is split up so Zeus does not freeze.
Key.English: Covers the whole theatre: buildings, forests and terrain. A window shows the duration, the number of items collected and the current sector. Athena must be linked. The run is split up so Zeus does not freeze.
Key.French: Parcourt tout le théâtre : bâtiments, forêts et relief. Une fenêtre indique la durée, le nombre d’éléments collectés et le secteur en cours. Athena doit être liée. Le parcours est découpé pour ne pas figer Zeus.

Key.Original: Area with strong radio interference. Place it on the map, an object or a player.
Key.English: Area with strong radio interference. Place it on the map, an object or a player.
Key.French: Zone avec forte interférence radio. Posez sur la carte, un objet ou un joueur.

Key.Original: Only from Zeus or the survey window
Key.English: Only from Zeus or the survey window
Key.French: Uniquement depuis Zeus ou la fenêtre de relevé
Distance maximum pour détecter les relais
